description: Detached single storey outbuilding at rear for use as playroom/Gym ( Retrospective )
decision_conditions: <p>The subject development, by reason of its size and siting, gives rise to an unsympathetic, incongruous, bulky, obtrusive and contrived form of development which fails to respect the scale, character, massing, composition and design of the host dwellinghouse and neighbouring properties. The subject development therefore results in a detrimental impact to the character and appearance of the subject dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area, contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The subject development, by reason of its size and siting, gives rise to amenity impacts in terms of overshadowing, loss of outlook, and an overbearing visual impact to the detriment of the residential and visual amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties Nos. 27 and 31 Boxtree Lane. The subject development is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
